name: The sender (illustrative)
role: an illustrative member of the harbour room who sends message #42, 'the ferry is late'; seen at a harbour-side window; never a real person

name: The keeper of House A
role: the runtime process in House A (illustrative); owns the harbour room at epoch 7; carries scrolls, rings A's bell, falls asleep at the window in ch05-s04 and wakes in ch06-s05

name: The keeper of House B
role: the runtime process in House B (illustrative); races A for an empty Plate in ch03-s02; claims epoch 8 in ch05; dies before opening in the claimed-not-opened case

name: The keeper of House C
role: the runtime process in House C (illustrative); takes over the room (epoch 9), restores it from the Well and relights the lantern

name: The first neighbour (celld follower, illustrative)
role: a celld follower node shown as a copyist at a window desk with a notebook and a small book press (fsync); its notebook is water-damaged in ch07-s06 case one and incomplete in case two

name: The second neighbour (celld follower, illustrative)
role: a second celld follower node; its notebook is complete in ch07-s06 case one and damaged in case two

name: The witness in the well (metaphor)
role: a small lamp-keeper on a ledge inside the Well cutaway who rings a bell at every change to an object: the film's picture of S3's internal witness component as Werner Vogels described it; a metaphor, not a person

name: The demonstrator's hand
role: the unseen narrator's one hand, a mid-life teacher's (never elderly), the only thing that reaches into the town from outside: always from the lower right, it pulls and reseats the red-tagged pins, turns Plate tiles on parchment inserts, and holds up a slip

name: Kenton Varda
role: Cloudflare; author of the 2020 Durable Objects, 2021 output-gate, 2022 workerd and 2024 SQLite posts; co-author of the 9 October 2026 joint post. Seen only at his desk, screen-left, under a warm lamp. Generic, dignified 2020s silhouette: no likeness is attempted and no appearance details are claimed; read apart from Ryan Dahl by side of frame, posture and lamp. Never given words beyond his published sentences, shown as attributed text.

name: Ryan Dahl
role: Deno, now Cloudflare; started celld; author of the supplied 28 October 2026 commit and the alarms and facets commits. Seen only at his desk, screen-right. Generic, dignified 2020s silhouette: no likeness is attempted and no appearance details are claimed. Never given words beyond his published sentences.

name: Bert Belder
role: named in the 9 October 2026 joint post as leading, with Ryan Dahl, the effort to make workerd self-hosting first-class. Appears only as a name card beside Ryan Dahl's desk (a second, out-of-focus chair); no figure detail, no words.

name: Werner Vogels
role: Amazon's CTO; author of 'Diving Deep on S3 Consistency' (20 April 2021). Appears once, as a standing silhouette at a lectern-height desk beside the Well cutaway, with a name card; generic, no likeness; only his published sentences as attributed text.
